notes.title: Customize Your Challenge – Update Live!
notes.content: [h2][b]Difficulty Update Available Now![/b][/h2][p]Some players said the game was [b]too easy[/b]. Others said it was [b]too hard[/b]. And many asked for [b]more creative ways to play[/b]. So I listened - and this free content update is for [i]all[/i] of you. With new difficulty settings and optional gameplay modifiers, you can now tailor the experience exactly how you want it. 👽[/p][p][/p][h3] 🔧[b]Difficulty Selection[/b][/h3][p]You can now choose between [b]Easy, Medium, and Hard[/b] difficulties when starting a game. Whether you're here for the story or a brutal challenge, there's a mode for you.[/p][p][/p][h3] 💀[b]Custom Difficulty Modifiers[/b][/h3][p]Looking for a truly custom experience? Activate one or more [b]Difficulty Modifiers[/b] to spice things up. Inspired by the Skull system in [i]Halo[/i], these optional tweaks dramatically change the way the game plays. You can unlock them by finding Dr Antonius' Research Logs![/p][p]Here's what you can enable:[/p][list][*][p][b]One Vision[/b] - Attaches a camera to the Survivor. All other cameras are disabled.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Finishing The Fight[/b] - John brings a gun instead of a flashlight.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Blind And Deaf[/b] - The Monster makes no sound when moving or breathing. Survivor icon is removed from the minimap.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Out of Time[/b] - Minigames no longer pause the game. Think fast.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Never Safe[/b] - All hiding spots are removed from the map.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Unlimited Power[/b] - Cameras & ship navigation systems are always online, no batteries required.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Speed[/b] - Survivor AND Monster movement speeds are increased by [b]50%[/b]. [/p][/*][/list][p]Mix and match to create your perfect nightmare.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176852/35e6b0033da831d67843dac4b4926f700c20e66b.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3] 🐞[b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b][/h3][p]This update also includes several bug fixes and quality-of-life tweaks:[/p][list][*][p]fixed a potential issue where the victory screen didn't show up in the prologue and Engineering Bay levels[/p][/*][*][p]added a checkpoint in the Spacewalk level after turning on the engines.[/p][/*][*][p] the monster now starts patrolling from the same point each level[/p][/*][*][p] the monster will now properly go to alarm location upon triggering it[/p][/*][*][p]QTE ui animation changed to not be misleading[/p][/*][*][p] symbols can now be pressed directly on their icon in addition to their corresponding button in the symbols minigame [/p][/*][*][p] hair is now visible on the player shadow[/p][/*][*][p]increased spacewalk movement speed by 50% and jump height slightly[/p][/*][*][p] added an option to skip the bridge sequence in the final boss level[/p][/*][*][p] clamped FOV slider to 70<->110 to prevent disjointed arm[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a bug where players would stay connected after the end credits rolled[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing, and we can't wait to see the challenges you create using the new modifiers. If you survive, let us know how you did. [/p][p][i]Tyci[/i][/p]

notes.title: Post-Launch Roadmap
notes.content:
It’s hard to believe it’s only been a week since the launch! 🎉What an emotional rollercoaster—equal parts excitement and stress—and I couldn’t be more grateful to everyone who picked up the game. Thank you so much for playing! 🙏 I hope you’re enjoying the core experience, even though it hasn’t been perfect. There were some frustrating freezes and crashes early on, but i appreciate everyone who pulled through to the end! ❤️

[h2]Where We Stand Now[/h2]
With those game-breaking freezes finally fixed, I don’t have any more hotfixes planned for the immediate future. 🛠️ Instead, I’ll be shifting focus toward larger, less frequent patches—tackling the bugs you reported and adding quality-of-life improvements. Your bug reports have been incredibly helpful; they’re guiding my next round of updates. Expect to see optimizations, polish, and new ways to make your experience even smoother. ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176852/3b08d03c95a7e55507281bcdfa7703af01213a0d.png[/img]

[h2]Free Content Update: Difficulty Modes (Coming Soon)[/h2]
One of the most common pieces of feedback has been that the default difficulty curve didn’t hit the right note for everyone—some of you found the monster too easy, while others thought certain minigames were too tough. To address that, I’m working on a free content update that will introduce multiple difficulty presets (Easy, Medium, Hard) plus extra modifiers you can mix and match for a more personalized challenge, e.g. the game not being paused during minigames. Think of it as a “build-your-own-difficulty”: if you want a more laid-back run, choose fewer modifiers; if you crave a hardcore experience, stack them and see how long you survive. More details on all the new modes and modifiers will be shared soon. 🎮🔧

[h2]📢What’s Next[/h2]
This difficulty update is just the first of several planned free updates—there’s more fun stuff on the horizon! Beyond difficulty options, I’m brainstorming new minigames, new gamemodes and even extra levels for those who want to dive deeper. 

From the bottom of my heart, thank you again for making this launch week unforgettable. Your enthusiasm and feedback are driving every decision I make—from bug fixes to new features and future content. Stay tuned,[url=https://discord.gg/4Pc6wsrTqX] join the discord [/url]and I can’t wait to show you what’s next! 😊
Tyci

notes.title: Out Now! Astrumis – Survive Together, My Debut Solo-Dev Release
notes.content:
[h1]SURVIVAL IS NO LONGER A DRILL! ‘ASTRUMIS - SURVIVE TOGETHER’ NOW AVAILABLE ON STEAM[/h1]

Hey everyone — I’m incredibly excited (and still kind of in disbelief) to finally announce that my first game, Astrumis – Survive Together, is now available on Steam!

This has been a solo project from start to finish — a true passion project. Inspired by some of my favorite sci-fi and horror experiences, I set out to create a co-op game that really leans hard into teamwork, communication, and suspense. Whether you’re guiding your partner from mission control or sneaking through dark corridors yourself, survival depends on how well you work together.

👉 To celebrate the launch, there's a brand-new trailer showcasing the game!
[previewyoutube=7whaSk8bGbg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Game Features:[/h2]
✔️ 100% co-op experience with two distinct gameplay roles
✔️ Friend Pass – one copy is all you need to play together
✔️ Survivor: Real-time action and hacking as John Kowalski
✔️ Mission Control: Strategic puzzles and navigation as Yang Sungbin
✔️ 9 story-driven levels with full voice acting and cinematic storytelling
✔️ A tense, story-rich sci-fi setting with secrets to uncover and systems to survive
✔️ Ongoing post-launch support with updates, new features, and expanded content

🖼️Some brand-new screenshots showcasing the gameplay:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176852/d8975791764a84846f9f96d39244f95c110f7783.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176852/c7b77d009c6a6f9b952f025340132979f6ced299.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176852/20ba4c915257f87a5239fe6f768a9fa681d20a21.png[/img]


This isn’t the end — not even close. I’m committed to supporting Astrumis post-launch with ongoing updates. That means bug fixes, quality-of-life improvements, and new free content down the line. I’m already working on new game modes and even additional story content. Your feedback is everything, so if you're playing, please share your thoughts — they’ll help shape what comes next.

You can grab Astrumis – Survive Together now on Steam. And if you want to share feedback, report bugs, or just talk about the game, join the community over on the Discord!

Thanks so much for supporting this wild solo dev journey.
– Tyci

notes.title: 3 Days Until Launch - Here's Everything You Need to Know
notes.content:
It’s been a long journey to get here, and now the finish line is in sight. With just a few days left, I want to give you a quick rundown of everything you need to know before launch — from exact release times to what’s happening with the demo, and how the new Friend Pass will work. Let’s get you ready for day one.
 
 [h2]🕔 Global Release Time[/h2]
 The game goes live at 5 PM GMT — here’s what that means in a few key time zones:
 
 [list]
 [*] 10 AM PT (Los Angeles)
 [*] 1 PM ET (New York)
 [*] 6 PM BST (UK)
 [*] 19:00 CEST (Central Europe)
 [*] 20:00 MSK (Moscow)
 [*] 01:00 JST (next day) (Tokyo)
 [/list]
 Be sure to check your local time so you don’t miss the launch!
 
 [h2]🚫 Demo Offline – Friend Pass Coming[/h2]
 As of this post, the demo is officially offline. This has been planned and previously announced — it’s being taken down so I can begin converting it into the [b]Friend Pass[/b]. Taking it offline now gives me the time to set everything up correctly, run final tests, and make sure it all works smoothly by launch.
 
 [b]What is the Friend Pass?[/b]
 After launch, the demo will return in a new form. With the [b]Friend Pass[/b], anyone who owns the game can invite a friend who doesn’t to join them in co-op multiplayer — no purchase required for the second player. It’s designed to make it easier to play together, without asking everyone to buy in right away.
 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176852/f4f1b5410e9bc2b66141f82556ba415be9e7e9e9.png[/img]
 
 [h2]🙌 Thank You[/h2]
 Thank you all so much for your support so far — from trying the demo, to sharing feedback, to just cheering this thing on. It’s been a wild ride building this game, and with the launch so close, I’m feeling a mix of stress, adrenaline, and pure excitement.
 
 We're almost there — see you at launch.
 
 Tycjan 'Tyci' Woronko

notes.title: Friend's Pass Incoming!
notes.content:
[h1]Converting the Demo into a Friend's Pass – Here’s What’s Happening![/h1]

Hey everyone!
First off — thank you so much for the overwhelming support and interest in the demo! It's been incredible seeing so many of you jumping in, sharing feedback, streaming, and getting excited about the game. The response has been way beyond what we expected, and it means the world. ❤️

[h2]🎮 What’s Next: The Friend's Pass[/h2]
I'm excited to share that we’re now preparing to convert the demo into a “[b]Friend's Pass[/b]” for launch!

If you’re not familiar with the concept, a [b]Friend's Pass[/b] lets a player who doesn’t own the game join a friend who does, and experience the full game together — for free. It’s perfect for co-op titles like ours, where the fun really shines when shared.

Here’s how it will work:
[list]
[*] If your friend owns the game, you’ll be able to download the Friend Pass version and join them in any part of the game.
[*] For those wanting to try out the game before buying — don’t worry! The Friend Pass will still let you enjoy the first three levels of the game for free, exactly like in the demo version.
[/list]
[h2]🔧 Why We're Disabling the Demo Soon[/h2]
To safely and cleanly make this transition, we’ll need to temporarily disable the demo a little before launch. This gives us time to:
[list]
[*] Rebuild and repackage the demo into the Friend Pass version
[*] Test multiplayer compatibility and edge cases
[*] Ensure everything is stable, polished, and ready for release
[/list]I'm planning to disable the demo a week before release, so if you haven’t played it yet — now’s your chance!


Again — thank you for playing, for wishlisting, and for helping us build momentum toward release. This game has always been about playing together, and we can’t wait to show you what we’ve been working on.
Tycjan 'Tyci' Woronko

notes.title: Devlog #3 - "Asteroid Escape" level spotlight
notes.content:
Hey, survivors! 😊

Today, we’re pulling back the curtain on one of the most intense missions in Astrumis: Survive Together—a high-stakes cooperative challenge that will test both players' coordination and reflexes. Get ready for "Asteroid Escape", where one player pilots a spaceship through an asteroid field while the other fights against shifting gravity inside! 🚀 🚀 

[h1]Mission Overview[/h1]
In Asteroid Escape, the two players take on distinct but interconnected roles:
[list]
[*]Yang is at the helm, piloting the ship through gaps in an oncoming asteroid field. The ship can rotate in multiple directions to fit through tight spaces, but every movement shifts the entire interior, affecting John inside.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176852/5aab0fecc7f72d763323d51492871a7197fe2881.gif[/img]
[*]John is inside the ship, dealing with the chaos Yang creates. Every time the ship rotates, John's entire world flips—walls become floors, ceilings become walkways, and he must adapt fast to avoid getting stranded.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176852/efb574eb2e55e0bdde7fb48cfa07062ad1721aa1.gif[/img]
[*]The ship’s power is unstable, and critical navigation systems will periodically lose power. That’s where John comes in—he must navigate the ever-changing environment to manually reconnect batteries so Yang can keep flying safely.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176852/7ff0518961d7bba1674170db1d4e1f5b5d1904a8.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Navigation Systems That Can Fail:[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Horizontal Control (Yaw): [/b]Rotating left or right.
[*][b]Vertical Control (Pitch):[/b] Tilting the ship up or down.
[*][b]Roll Control:[/b] Flipping the ship entirely.
[*][b]Cannons: [/b]Limited firepower for clearing asteroids.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176852/52d80e7a7130b2ac87f574f6dd442b3ff0c48b26.gif[/img]
If a system fails at the wrong time, Yang might be flying blind, and John must hurry to fix it—while walking on walls and ceilings!


Stay tuned for more devlogs! For more regular updates join the [url=https://discord.gg/4Pc6wsrTqX]discord here![/url]
Tycjan Woronko / Tyci

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Mission Control Rework
notes.content:
Hey everyone 👋
Today, I’m excited to talk about a major update coming to Mission Control in Astrumis Survive Together! After some great feedback from players, we’ve reworked the role to provide more engagement and strategy, addressing the concern that Mission Control often felt like they were just waiting around with little to do. 

[h1]The Old System:[/h1]
In the original design, Mission Control had the ability to toggle between various cameras freely. Their role was mainly about providing directions to the other player by guiding them through the environment and warning them about incoming monsters. While this was effective for a while, we realized that it left Mission Control feeling like a passive observer, leading to some complaints about limited engagement.

[h1]The New System:[/h1]
Mission Control now has to actively manage power resources in order to access different camera feeds. Rather than simply toggling between cameras at will, players will need to manage a finite amount of Power Cells that are required to activate them. Here’s how it works: 🔋🪫

[h3]Power Cells: [/h3]
Cameras require Power Cells to turn on. Most cameras need just one, but some will require two! Capacity is marked with these small icons. Players must monitor their available Power Cells and decide which cameras are most crucial at any given time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176852/f1e49e0f16dfb869189678216006c1aac71ae910.gif[/img]

[h3]Drag and Drop: [/h3]
Power Cells can be moved between cameras by dragging and dropping them. This system allows Mission Control to prioritize cameras based on the needs of the other player, who may be navigating through dangerous environments or avoiding monsters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176852/5c7531dd68a2064671523773411054ce1d8d9578.gif[/img]

[h3]Limited Power: [/h3]
There’s a limited supply of Power Cells across the map, meaning Mission Control will have to make strategic decisions. Should you activate the camera that will help the player avoid a monster right now, or should you prioritize a different one that might help them navigate to a safer location later? Players will need to plan ahead, and sometimes make tough choices, as there simply won’t be enough Power Cells to keep everything running.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176852/195c071779cc947a78d2c2ed7a1a50171fa4862d.gif[/img]

[h1]What’s Next?[/h1]
This change will go live with the next patch coming soon! I’ll be closely monitoring how players adapt to this new system, and I am excited to gather more feedback for future updates. Mission Control’s toolkit has been even further expanded, but I don't want reveal everything right away! 😏😏
~Tyci
